name: It just clicked
description: Prompt-described adult man in his mid-20s with dark hair, light stubble, a black baseball cap, and a faded blue T-shirt in a simple bedroom. Close chest-up selfie with a plain wall, partly open door, and soft blue ceiling LEDs. Focused neutral expression becomes a subtle realization: slightly raised eyebrows, a quick closed-mouth smile, one tiny head shake, and a hand briefly near his chin. Understated discovery, not exaggerated shock. Tags are prompt-derived, not visually verified.
sourcePrompt: Four-second vertical iPhone selfie video, very close framing from chest to just above the head. A man in his mid-20s with dark hair, light stubble, a black baseball cap, and a faded blue T-shirt sits in a simple bedroom. A plain wall, partly open door, and soft blue LED strip along the ceiling are visible behind him. He looks into the camera with a focused, neutral face. Then the idea seems to click: his eyebrows lift slightly, he gives a quick closed-mouth smile, and shakes his head once, very subtly, as if thinking, ‘I can’t believe I missed that.’ His free hand briefly rises near his chin and drops out of frame. Slight handheld phone movement, ordinary room lighting, real-time motion. No talking, captions, exaggerated reaction, or polished studio look.
